summary: The run accumulated substantial damage before the final multi-enemy fight and then entered that fight at only 44/72 HP with no potions. The most consequential strategic error was choosing to smith instead of rest at the preceding campfire. In the final combat, the agent continued prioritizing damage after reaching critical HP despite legal defensive options and multiple attacking Sentries.

lessons.title: Heal before a dangerous upcoming fight when already below full health
lessons.situation: At a campfire with substantially reduced HP and no healing resources available, especially when the next encounter may be a difficult multi-enemy fight.
lessons.lesson: Prefer rest over smithing when entering the next fight at roughly 60% of maximum HP unless the upgrade is clearly necessary for survival. Preserving enough HP to survive the fight is more valuable than a modest upgrade.
evidence_points: At Floor 7, the agent had 44/72 HP and chose smith: Upgrade one card instead of rest.
The final combat began at 44/72 HP, and the run ended with the player at 2/72 HP while multiple Sentries remained alive.
The final build lists no potions, so there was no recorded emergency healing resource to compensate for the low campfire HP.
lessons.reasoning: The campfire was the last explicit opportunity to increase survivability before the final fight. The unchanged 44/72 HP entering combat left very little margin, and the eventual death occurred after that reserve was exhausted.

lessons.title: At critical HP, defend against attacks instead of spending the last energy on damage
lessons.situation: When HP is very low, block is zero or nearly zero, and one or more enemies show an attack intent while a Defend is legally playable.
lessons.lesson: Once survival is at risk, prioritize a legal defensive card over additional damage unless the attack definitively ends the threat. Reassess after each action because a damage-first line can leave no protection for the remaining attackers.
evidence_points: On Turn 8, the player had 2/72 HP and 0 Block; after killing the 4-HP Sentry with Rampage+, the two remaining Sentries both had ATTACK intent.
After that attack, the hand still contained Defend and Defend was a legal alternative, but the agent chose Clothesline instead while remaining at 2/72 HP and 0 Block.
Earlier on Turn 5, at 16/72 HP and 0 Block with an attacking Sentry present, the agent also selected Clothesline before using its remaining energy on Defend.
lessons.reasoning: The final Turn 8 state provides a clear survival check: damage was no longer sufficient by itself because two attackers remained, while Defend was available. The subsequent Clothesline added no block and left the player exposed at lethal-range HP; the same damage-over-defense tendency was visible earlier at 16 HP.
